title: Galante 1967 anterior AF strip elongation to failure, along fibres

quantity.name: elongation to failure
quantity.definition: elongation to failure of 10 mm central section (clamp-to-clamp)

source.sample: 38 anterior AF strips from 6 lumbar spines (33 analysed) (study total: 592 samples from 68 autopsy lumbar spines)

protocol.summary: Die-cut anterior AF samples with reduced central section 10 x 2 x 1 mm (ends 7.5 x 3 x 1 mm), cut along one fibre direction or along the horizontal (circumferential) axis; tested in air at 90% RH and 21 C; tension to failure at 0.5 cm/min (5 mm/min); ultimate strength in kp/mm2 and elongation to failure (mm). Values are mean +- standard ERROR (Statistical methods).
how_to_simulate: Model a 10 x 2 x 1 mm AF strip (central section) loaded along the fibre direction or horizontally (circumferential)
Pull at 5 mm/min to failure (clamped strip, no bone)
Report ultimate stress (force / initial CSA) and elongation at failure

extraction.check_notes: Results text p.66-67; values mean +- SE (converted: 1 kp/mm2 = 9.80665 MPa; SE converted likewise and stored in 'se', SD not given).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
